definition: A neural network architecture designed to operate directly on graph-structured data by passing and aggregating information between connected nodes.
details: GNNs are used in applications ranging from molecule property prediction to recommendation systems and knowledge graph reasoning.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Graph Neural Network.
